basis: bHLH TF for guard-cell differentiation (Ohashi-Ito & Bergmann 2006 Plant Cell); Lee 2025 silique c16 (rank 4), used for the paper's guard label. Also specifies myrosin idioblasts in Brassicaceae (TGG2 is rank 2 in c16).
Myrosinase abundant in guard cells (Zhao et al. 2008 Plant Cell) and in myrosin cells (Barth & Jander 2006 Plant J); top DE gene of Lee 2025 silique c16. Not guard-specific.

ABC transporter (monolignol transport in root endodermis; Alejandro et al. 2012 Curr Biol); silique guard cells by MERFISH and c16 rank 6 (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 2). Function unrelated to guard cells; silique-specific use.

Senescence NAC TF (Guo & Gan 2006 Plant J); called a silique-specific guard-cell marker from single-cell data only (Lee 2025 Supp. Fig. 14d; c16 rank 9). Senescence-induced, so may follow silique age.
Ca2+-ATPase on the Lee 2025 silique MERFISH panel; weak in c16 (rank 58, pct.1 below pct.2). Not spatially confirmed in guard cells.

Myrosinase of phloem-associated myrosin cells, not guard cells (Barth & Jander 2006 Plant J); rank 2 in Lee 2025 silique c16 (labeled Guard), so c16 probably also holds myrosin cells. Use with FAMA and without KAT1/SLAC1.
HD-ZIP IV L1-identity TF (Lu et al. 1996 Plant Cell). Pan-epidermal: exocarp, seed-coat oi2 (Rombi 2026 MERFISH) and embryo protoderm all express it. Not DE in Lee 2025 silique.

Epidermis-specific KCS for cuticle (Yephremov et al. 1999 Plant Cell; Pruitt et al. 2000 PNAS). Conflict in silique: DE only in Lee 2025 c11 (rank 26; seed-coat endothelium program), not in exocarp c9.
MLP/Bet v1-family protein (uncharacterized); exocarp by silique MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) and top DE gene of c9 (labeled Epidermal partly from this gene, so one study).
JA-inducible vegetative storage protein; exocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Extended Data Fig. 6d) but not a DE gene of any silique cluster. Wound/JA-responsive, so expect state effects.
Remorin; exocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3). Weak in snRNA (c16 rank 59; pct.1 below pct.2 in c15). Guard cells are part of the exocarp.
Uncharacterized; exocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); weak DE in c2 (labeled Vascular).
Filament-like plant protein; exocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) but rank 6 in c4 (labeled Xylem). Conflict: c4 may be a lignifying valve layer.
TPX2-family protein; exocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Extended Data Fig. 6f) but DE in c4 (labeled Xylem). Conflict as for FPP7.
Uncharacterized; mesocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); not DE in any silique cluster. Combine with chlorenchyma genes (RBCS, LHCB) from arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.
SDR oxidoreductase; mesocarp by silique MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3). Conflict: the same paper calls it a sepal/petal outer-epidermis marker in flowers; only weak DE in silique c4/c10/c21.

DUF220 protein; endocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) and rank 2 in c18 ("Phloem (tip)"), with PCD genes (MC9, BFN1) that fit endocarp a. Conflict: nucellus markers SWEET15 and AGO3 are also DE in c18.
DUF707 protein; endocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) and rank 4 in c22 (labeled Phloem without stated evidence).
Transmembrane protein; endocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) and DE in c22 (rank 21).
Ribitol dehydrogenase-like SDR; endocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) and rank 4 in c12 (secondary-wall program; candidate endocarp b).
Mannitol dehydrogenase/CAD-family defense protein; endocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) and rank 4 in c25 (senescence program: SAG12, NAC072).
Probable polygalacturonase; endocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); weak DE in c4 (rank 87).
Nitrile-specifier protein; endocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) but DE in the maturing-embryo cluster c5 (rank 8). Conflict.
Uncharacterized; endocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) but top DE gene of c21, which has male-germline genes (MGH3). Conflict.
CCR-like SDR; endocarp by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) but rank 7 in c11 (seed-coat endothelium program). Conflict: may be endothelium.

MADS TF for valve differentiation; valve in situ and ful valves fail to expand (Gu et al. 1998 Development). Carpel-valve MERFISH in Lee 2025 flower (independent). Not DE in silique snRNA; also stem and cauline leaves.
bHLH TF for valve-margin lignified and separation layers; ind siliques indehiscent (Liljegren et al. 2004 Cell). Classic; not DE in Lee 2025 silique.
MADS TF for valve-margin identity, redundant with SHP2 (Liljegren et al. 2000 Nature); also ovules and seed coat. Not DE in Lee 2025 silique.
MADS TF for valve-margin identity, redundant with SHP1 (Liljegren et al. 2000 Nature); also ovules. Not DE in Lee 2025 silique.
bHLH TF for the valve-margin separation layer (Rajani & Sundaresan 2001 Curr Biol). Not DE in Lee 2025 silique.
BELL homeobox TF for replum identity; rpl replum reduced (Roeder et al. 2003 Curr Biol). Also inflorescence meristem and stem. Not DE in Lee 2025 silique.
Zinc-finger TF for transmitting-tract development in the septum (Crawford et al. 2007 Curr Biol). Degenerates after fertilization; not DE in Lee 2025 silique.

Companion-cell sucrose/H+ symporter, promoter reporter (Truernit & Sauer 1995 Planta). Lee 2025 silique c20 (rank 12; used for its label) and weak in c14/c15; funiculus companion cells in Martin 2026.

PM H+-ATPase with companion-cell promoter-GUS (DeWitt & Sussman 1995 Plant Cell). Cross-study: DE in Lee 2025 silique c20 (rank 17), which the paper labeled from SUC2/FT/MT2B, not AHA3. Medium raised to high.

Florigen expressed in leaf phloem companion cells (Takada & Goto 2003 Plant Cell; An et al. 2004 Development); GUS in silique replum/septum/valve vasculature (Mizzotti et al. 2018); Lee 2025 silique c20 rank 4 (used for the label).
Companion-cell heavy-metal-associated protein (Tian et al. 2010 Plant Cell). Conflict in silique: DE in c24 (DEFL/synergid-like) and c14, not in the companion-cell cluster c20.

Amino-acid permease of the phloem, promoter-GUS in silique and funiculus vasculature (Hirner et al. 1998 Plant J; Zhang et al. 2010 Plant Cell). Cross-study: top DE gene of Lee 2025 silique c20, which the paper did not label with it. Medium raised to high. SE vs CC not resolved.

Sucrose exporter of phloem parenchyma (Chen et al. 2012 Science); also seed coat (Chen et al. 2015 Plant Cell). Conflict in silique: DE only in Lee 2025 c15 (rank 10), whose other genes are ESR endosperm (RGP3, ALE1, ZOU).

Tracheary-element cysteine protease for micro-autolysis (Avci et al. 2008 Plant J); Lee 2025 silique c4 rank 15 (c4 labeled from XCP1, not XCP2) and stem MERFISH. c4 may also hold lignifying valve layers.

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; irx5 collapsed xylem (Taylor et al. 2003 PNAS); Lee 2025 silique c4 rank 22. In fruit, secondary-wall CESAs also mark endocarp b and the valve-margin lignified layer, so medium here.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (Taylor et al. 2000 Plant Cell); Lee 2025 silique c4 rank 20. Also endocarp b and valve-margin lignified cells.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (Taylor et al. 1999 Plant Cell); Lee 2025 silique c4 (rank 62) and c12. Also endocarp b.
Secondary-wall xylan/pectin glycosyltransferase; irx8 collapsed xylem (Persson et al. 2007 Plant Cell); Lee 2025 silique c4 rank 10. Also fibers and endocarp b.
HD-ZIP III TF of procambium and xylem precursors (Baima et al. 1995 Development); Lee 2025 silique c12 rank 22, used for the paper's label.

HD-ZIP IV TF required for oi2 mucilage-secretory cell differentiation (Western et al. 2001 Plant Physiol; Windsor et al. 2000 Plant J). Cross-study: rank 2 in Lee 2025 silique c7, which the paper labeled "Phloem (embryo)"; used as oi2 marker in Martin 2026, Picard 2021 and Rombi 2026. Also trichomes and root atrichoblasts.

UDP-rhamnose synthase needed for seed mucilage, upregulated in the seed-coat epidermis during mucilage synthesis (Western et al. 2004 Plant Physiol). Lee 2025 silique c7 rank 18. Also broadly expressed at lower level.

bHLH of the proanthocyanidin MBW complex (Nesi et al. 2000 Plant Cell); expressed in endothelium and in oi2/chalaza. DE in both Lee 2025 c7 (oi2) and c11 (endothelium); Picard 2021 curated it for endothelium/oi2.

Anthocyanidin reductase for proanthocyanidins, endothelium-specific promoter reporter (Debeaujon et al. 2003 Plant Cell). Cross-study: rank 2 in Lee 2025 silique c11, which the paper labeled "Epidermal" from FDH; endothelium marker in Martin 2026, Picard 2021 and Rombi 2026.

Leucoanthocyanidin dioxygenase of the PA pathway, essential for PA synthesis in the seed coat; tds4 seeds lack PA (Abrahams et al. 2003 Plant J). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c11 rank 3 (not used by the paper) and endothelium marker in Rombi 2026. Medium raised to high; also anthocyanin cells elsewhere.

Dihydroflavonol reductase of the PA pathway; tt3 seeds lack PA; promoter active in endothelium (Debeaujon et al. 2003 Plant Cell). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c11 rank 9 and Rombi 2026 endothelium list. Medium raised to high; also anthocyanin cells.

Glutathione S-transferase for PA/anthocyanin vacuolar transport, expressed in the endothelium (Kitamura et al. 2004 Plant J). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c11 rank 10 and Rombi 2026 endothelium list. Medium raised to high.
MATE transporter of PA precursors, endothelium-specific (Debeaujon et al. 2001 Plant Cell); Rombi 2026 list. Not DE in Lee 2025 silique.
R2R3-MYB of the PA MBW complex, expressed in the endothelium (Nesi et al. 2001 Plant Cell); Picard 2021 curated. Not DE in Lee 2025 silique.

WIP zinc-finger TF for endothelium development, ovule-stage ii1 expression (Sagasser et al. 2002 Genes Dev). In Lee 2025 silique it is DE in c23 (unfertilized-ovule-like, rank 11), consistent with early expression.
Vacuolar processing enzyme for PCD of ii1'/ii2 (Nakaune et al. 2005 Plant Cell); Martin 2026 ii1'/ii2 marker. Only weak DE in Lee 2025 (c4, c17).

Amino-acid exporter; ii1' by MERFISH (Rombi 2026). Rank 3 in Lee 2025 silique c17 together with UMAMIT25 and SIAR1, so c17 is probably ii1'/chalazal seed coat rather than the paper's "Phloem" (the paper labeled c17 with UMAMIT12, so not counted as agreement).
Amino-acid exporter; ii1' by MERFISH (Rombi 2026) and by Muller 2016 (thesis, cited in Martin 2026). Not DE in Lee 2025 silique.

Amino-acid exporter; ii1' by MERFISH (Rombi 2026) and Lee 2025 c17 rank 13. Conflict: in situ in micropylar endosperm plus seed coat (Picard 2021 ED Fig. 6b) and seed-loading exporter in endosperm/seed coat (Besnard et al. 2018 J Exp Bot).

Feruloyl transferase for seed-coat suberin; asft seed coats lack ferulate and are permeable (Molina et al. 2009 Plant Physiol). Lee 2025 silique c13 (rank 12; unlabeled). Suberin is in oi1 and the chalaza, so c13 may be chalazal seed coat.
R2R3-MYB required for seed-coat suberin (Gou et al. 2017 Plant Physiol; Lashbrooke et al. 2016 Plant Cell); Lee 2025 silique c13 rank 36. Same oi1/chalaza caveat as ASFT.

Amino-acid exporter for seed loading, promoter reporter in chalazal seed coat and phloem (Muller et al. 2015 Curr Biol). Cross-study: chalazal unloading domain by MERFISH in Rombi 2026 and placentochalazal seed-coat marker in Martin 2026. Only weak DE in Lee 2025 (c2/c3).

Callose synthase; chalazal unloading domain by MERFISH (Rombi 2026) and chalazal seed coat by LCM (Le et al. 2010 PNAS), placentochalazal marker in Martin 2026. Medium raised to high. Not DE in Lee 2025.
bZIP TF; chalazal unloading domain by reporter and MERFISH (Rombi 2026). Lee 2025 used it as a leaf phloem marker (Kim 2021); DE only weakly in c7/c9 there. Phloem-end identity.
Sugar transporter; placentochalazal seed coat by HCR (Martin 2026 Fig. 2f). Weak DE in Lee 2025 c2.

Type-A response regulator, chalaza-specific promoter reporter (Horak et al. 2008 BMC Plant Biol); chalazal seed-coat marker in Martin 2026 and Rombi 2026 (both from literature). Not enriched in Lee 2025.
Amino-acid exporter (Ladwig et al. 2012 Plant Physiol); seed abscission zone by MERFISH (Rombi 2026). Lee 2025 c17 rank 12 (paper labeled c17 phloem parenchyma from SIAR1). Also phloem.

Polygalacturonase required for seed abscission at the funiculus/hilum and silique dehiscence (Ogawa et al. 2009 Plant Cell); Martin 2026 hilum marker. Also valve-margin separation layer. Not DE in Lee 2025.

Argonaute; chalazal persistent nucellus by HCR (Martin 2026 Fig. 2c) and promoter activity (Jullien et al. 2020 Plant J); nucellus cluster in Rombi 2026. Medium raised to high. Weak in Lee 2025 (c18 rank 87).
Sugar transporter; nucellus by reporter (Rombi 2026). Lee 2025 c18 rank 47. Also senescence-induced and seed coat (Chen et al. 2015 Plant Cell).

DUF239 protein (uncharacterized); chalazal endosperm cyst by in situ (Picard et al. 2021 Nat Plants Fig. 2), CZE marker in Martin 2026, Lee 2025 MERFISH probe (Fig. 3) and rank 3 in c14. Medium raised to high.
Heavy-metal-associated protein; CZE cyst by in situ (Picard 2021 Fig. 2) and LCM (Le et al. 2010), CZE marker in Martin 2026, and DE in Lee 2025 c14 (rank 81). Medium raised to high.
Nitrate/peptide transporter family; CZE by HCR at 7 DAP (Martin 2026 Supp. Fig. 5, not viewed); DE in Lee 2025 c14 (rank 101). Not raised: Lee enrichment is weak.
Uncharacterized; CZE apical cyst and nodules by HCR (Martin 2026 Fig. 4c). Lee 2025: c14 rank 85 and c24 rank 3, so c24 may contain chalazal endosperm.
GA 20-oxidase; CZE nodules by in situ (Picard 2021 Fig. 2, ED Fig. 6c). Not DE in Lee 2025.
D-type cyclin; CZE nodules by in situ (Picard 2021 Fig. 2); Martin 2026 cites Picard (not independent). Not DE in Lee 2025.

bHLH TF expressed only in the embryo-surrounding region; zou endosperm persists (Yang et al. 2008 Development). ESR marker in Picard 2021, Martin 2026, Rombi 2026; DE in Lee 2025 c15 (rank 65), which the paper left Unknown.
Subtilase expressed in the ESR; ale1 embryos have cuticle defects (Tanaka et al. 2001 Development). Cross-study: rank 18 in Lee 2025 c15 (unlabeled) and ESR marker in Martin 2026 and Rombi 2026.
ESR-expressed peptide (KERBEROS) required for embryo cuticle (Moussu et al. 2017 Plant Cell); Martin 2026 and Rombi 2026 ESR list. Weak in Lee 2025 c15 (rank 113).

Reversibly glycosylated polypeptide; ESR marker (Fourquin et al. 2016 Development, cited in Martin 2026). Cross-study: top DE gene of Lee 2025 c15, which the paper left Unknown (its annotation text mentions RGP3 as endosperm). Medium raised to high.
GDSL lipase; ESR at 7 DAP by HCR (Martin 2026 Extended Data Fig. 6c; one experiment) and DE in Lee 2025 c15 (rank 28). Agreement noted but not raised because the HCR was a single experiment.
MADS TF expressed only in syncytial endosperm; agl62 cellularizes early (Kang et al. 2008 Plant Cell). Early stages only; not DE in Lee 2025 silique.
Sucrose transporter expressed in the endosperm during early seed filling (Baud et al. 2005 Plant J); Rombi 2026 endosperm list. Not DE in Lee 2025 silique.
WUS-homeobox TF of the basal lineage and suspensor, reporter (Haecker et al. 2004 Development); suspensor marker in Martin 2026. DE in Lee 2025 c15 (rank 33), which also holds ESR endosperm.
L1-specific protodermal factor (Abe et al. 1999 Plant Cell Physiol); embryo protoderm by HCR (Martin 2026 Fig. 1h); DE in Lee 2025 maturing embryo c5 (rank 27). Pan-epidermal outside the seed.
NF-YB master regulator of embryo maturation, expressed in embryo and endosperm during seed development (Lotan et al. 1998 Cell). Not DE in Lee 2025 silique.
B3 TF of seed maturation, expressed in the embryo (Parcy et al. 1994 Plant Cell); weak in Lee 2025 c5 (rank 79). Maturation stage only.
12S cruciferin storage protein of the maturing embryo; top DE gene of Lee 2025 c5. Maturation stage only (embryo storage-filling state).
12S cruciferin storage protein; Lee 2025 c5 rank 5. Maturation stage only.
2S albumin storage protein; Lee 2025 c5 rank 2. Maturation stage only.
Oleosin of oil bodies in embryo and endosperm; Lee 2025 c5 rank 4. Also a whole-embryo early-germination marker (Liew 2024).
Synergid-specific MYB for the filiform apparatus (Kasahara et al. 2005 Plant Cell). Unfertilized ovules only; not DE in Lee 2025 silique (c24 has the DEFL program).
Egg-cell-specific secreted peptide for gamete fusion (Sprunck et al. 2012 Science). Unfertilized ovules only; not DE in Lee 2025 silique.

Pollen-specific arabinogalactan protein; agp6 agp11 pollen-tube defects (Levitin et al. 2008 Plant J). Cross-study: rank 12 in Lee 2025 silique c19, which the paper labeled "Phloem (embryo...)". Pollen in a silique sample is contamination.
Pollen-specific arabinogalactan protein (Levitin et al. 2008 Plant J). Cross-study: rank 8 in Lee 2025 silique c19, labeled phloem by the paper. Contamination flag.
Male-gamete-specific histone H3, reporter in generative and sperm cells (Okada et al. 2005 Plant J); DE in Lee 2025 silique c21 (rank 51). Contamination flag (pollen tubes).
APC/C activator at mitosis (Kevei et al. 2011 PLoS One); top DE gene of Lee 2025 silique c6 ("Embryo (dividing)"), used for the paper's label.
DNA topoisomerase II, S/G2-M; Lee 2025 silique c6 rank 12; MERFISH proliferation marker in the seedling part of the same paper.

3xHMG-box protein of mitotic chromosomes; spotty in dividing endosperm nuclei by in situ (Picard 2021 ED Fig. 6b). Cross-study: Lee 2025 silique c6 rank 13 (not used for the label). Medium raised to high.
Senescence-specific cysteine protease (Lohman et al. 1994 Physiol Plant); Lee 2025 silique c25 (rank 65) with NAC072/055 and bZIP1.
Heat-induced heat-shock TF (Nishizawa et al. 2006 Plant J); Lee 2025 silique c8 ("Unknown") with DREB2A and MBF1C. A state, not a type.
Heat-shock protein for thermotolerance (Queitsch et al. 2000 Plant Cell); Lee 2025 silique c10 (labeled Embryo) rank 14 with HSP70B and HSP17.6A.
R2R3-MYB of aliphatic glucosinolate biosynthesis (Hirai et al. 2007 PNAS); Lee 2025 silique c3 (rank 28) with IMS3, BCAT4 and FMO-GS. Metabolic program of phloem-associated cells, not a type.
Methionine-chain-elongation aminotransferase of aliphatic glucosinolates, phloem-associated promoter activity (Schuster et al. 2006 Plant Cell); Lee 2025 silique c3 rank 10, also c2 and c16.
